system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

You can amplify any Jutsu your allies cast with your Nature Release and even give it the properties of such. When an allied creature within 30 feet of you cast a jutsu while you are in Elemental Flux, you may spend 1 Superiority Die. It gains the keyword associated with your Flux type and it benefits from your Elemental Flux based on the shared nature release.
